Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Green eyes; ridged horns curving back over the crown; long pointed ears with a brass bell earring.
  • Wide red obi with a large bow over a gold under-band; red cord knot with brass bell and tassel — the warm accents in a green-grey figure. Plain wooden staff.
  • Mountain-crone weight: she protects by consuming. Never draw her as merely monstrous.
  • Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
